images.caption:
This is a strength report (personnel/status report) dated 20 (27) March 1945 from the Waffen-SS concentration / labor camp (Konz. Lager Bu. Arbeitslager Allendorf). It lists medical personnel and prisoners in the camp, including SS doctors, guards, and inmates, some of whom are identified by name and number, as well as a trust medic (Vertrauensarzt). Under the signatures of the SS command staff, the document gives a glimpse into the camp’s administrative structure and the medical-care arrangements very late in the war. The source is from the Arolsen Archives (DocID 82073623).
Konzentrationslager Allendorf (also called Arbeitslager Allendorf, or “Allendorf subcamp”) was a satellite camp of Buchenwald near the town of Allendorf, now Stadtallendorf, in Hesse, Germany.
